## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Fix the missing backup before merging: migration 3 permanently discards legacy email values written after migration 2.

## Changes
The pull request adds migrations to drop `users.legacy_email` and `orders.coupon_code`, backs up orders, and extends migration tests.

## Critical
- migrations/m0003_drop_legacy_email.py:7 — correctness — Back up users before dropping legacy_email — For users created or updated after migration 2, migration 3 deletes their current `legacy_email` without preserving it. `users_backup_2` predates those values, and this migration omits the backup required by the destructive-migration contract in `migrations/safety.py:1`. — Deploying migration 3 loses those legacy addresses and leaves no current snapshot for recovery if the deployment needs reverting. — Fix: Call `backup_table(conn, "users", VERSION)` before dropping the column and extend `test_drop_retired_columns` to verify preservation.
